title: Emotional Rescue | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Emotional Rescue is a 6.00 bedroom, 7.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Emotional Rescue: Your ultimate luxury getaway! This exceptional home comfortably hosts 20 guests with 6 bedrooms, 6 full baths, and 2 half baths. Enjoy Gulf views, TVs in every room, and Wi-Fi. Outside, find the largest pool, poolside kitchen, and beach volleyball court. Elevator access ensures convenience. Book now for an unforgettable stay!Main House:1st Floor: Discover a king bedroom with a TV and a private shower. There's also a bedroom with 2 twins and a TV, offering flexibility to convert them into a king bed. Completing this level is a hall shower bath.2nd Floor: Large king master bedroom has a private balcony outfitted with cocktail table and barstools as well as a large private master bath with dual vanity, soaking tub, and marble shower. Laundry room with front loading washer and dryer. Hall shower bath. Bedroom with queen-over-queen bunk as well as a separate queen bed. Off the 2nd floor landing is a porch overlooking the pool.3rd Floor: The main living area, dining room, and kitchen are on this floor to offer the best Gulf views. The comfortable living area has a sectional sofa with lounger, love seat, side chair and large TV. The dining table seats 10. Open concept kitchen has a breakfast bar and stainless appliances by Thermador and KitchenAid. Powder room. Balcony off living area has outdoor dining and a built-in cushioned settee that can be made into a lounging area. Amazing Gulf views!Roof Deck: It's the best spot in the house, with awesome views of the beach, Gulf, and nearby Rosemary Beach. There's a cool wet bar with a mini fridge and TV, a flying bed for chilling in the breeze, a comfy built-in booth, and a spot for drinks with friends. Perfect for catching the sunrise or sunset!West Wing:1st Floor: Adjacent to the pool, accessed either from the pool area or from a side door. Living area overlooks pool through the wall of sliding glass doors and features a queen sleeper sofa, 75” LED TV and a Blu-ray. The kitchen has smaller sized stainless appliances. Powder room. Additional patio with outdoor dining table.2nd Floor: The king master bedroom features a spacious en suite with dual vanities, a walk-in shower, a private balcony, and a TV for added comfort. The second bedroom includes a queen-over-queen bunk and a mounted TV. While the layout is more open than a traditional bedroom, it is enclosed with locking doors to ensure privacy and comfort. A hall shower bath and laundry closet are also located on this level.Outside:Large pool equipped with swim-up bar, kitchenette, and TV. Additional amenities include a surfboard shower, beach volleyball court, and plenty of loungers for basking in the Florida sun. Plus every booking includes a free golf cart for added convenience!Golf Cart Included:Enjoy a hassle-free 30A vacation with a gas-powered, 6-seater golf cart, fully street legal and included with your rental through Vacayzen and Benchmark Management.Your stay at Emotional Rescue comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee* Parking for 5 cars* This is a non-smoking and non-vaping home; a $500.00 fee will be assessed for smoking or vaping.A starter set of amenities is provided: The kitchen includes paper towels, a sponge, dish soap, dishwasher pods, kitchen wipes, trash liners, and laundry pods. Each bathroom has toilet paper, facial and bath soaps, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. Towels include one body towel and washcloth per guest, plus two hand towels per bathroom.
